name: Numinous
quote: RAM: 16 GB minimum (32 GB recommended for concurrent sandbox execution); CPU: 4 cores minimum (8+ recommended); Disk: 100 GB SSD
notes: Miners only need Python 3.11+ and gateway API keys (agents execute in validator sandboxes); repo documents CPU-only validator hardware, no GPU anywhere.

name: ORO
quote: RAM 16 GB 32 GB Storage 100 GB SSD 200 GB NVMe SSD Network 100 Mbps 1 Gbps GPU Not required Not required
notes: Official ORO docs hardware table (linked from repo README) states GPU 'Not required' for min and recommended validator specs.

name: Trishool
notes: Repo exists; requirements cover only Docker + Node.js 18+ and Chutes/OpenRouter API keys - no GPU or hardware spec documented.

name: Epago
quote: which is why a single consumer GPU is enough to fine-tune and duel it
notes: Miners fine-tune a 30B MoE (3.3B active) checkpoint; docs name no model/VRAM (single consumer GPU) and validator 'GPU eval box' is sized empirically (8x RTX 5090 cited only as a measurement).

name: Instant
quote: 1 vCPU; 2 GB RAM; 50 GB SSD; Ubuntu 22.04+ (x86_64); Stable internet connection; No GPU required
notes: Rust validator README lists explicit minimum requirements ending with 'No GPU required'.

name: Ridges
notes: Repo exists but README/docs contain no hardware or GPU requirements (agents are evaluated on the Ridges platform); no official hardware page found.

name: Leadpoet
notes: Repo and docs/miner-model-submissions.md cover model submissions and the arena only - no hardware or GPU requirements documented.

name: Umi
quote: GPU Not required ; OS Linux/Unix recommended; Docker deployment supported ; Network Must have outbound access to Chutes API, Bittensor network
notes: Official bittensor.ai subnet directory page (Voice AI Model Evaluation - SN78) states miner GPU 'Not required'; repo README is hardware-silent.

name: Actual
notes: Repo returns 404 (org actual-computer only hosts a llama.cpp fork); web search found only news mentions (NVIDIA Inception, Blackwell-optimized), no documented miner GPU requirement.

name: Beam
notes: Real repo is Beam-Network/beam (org page lists beam, beam-core-public, beam-sdk-public); README/docs require only Go 1.24+/Python 3.10-3.12/hotkey/network - no GPU requirement documented.

name: everyframe.studio
quote: Hardware Requirements Miner GPU Not required RAM 8 GB Storage 10 GB
notes: Repo everyframe-studios/everyframe-miner deleted (404), but official bittensor.ai directory page documents CPU-only miner (GPU not required, 8 GB RAM).

name: Attelier
quote: GPU optional depending on model implementation. Reference model runs on CPU.
notes: Repo attelierai/attelierai_subnet deleted (404); official bittensor.ai page (Poker Bot Detection) says miner GPU not required (optional), reference model runs on CPU.
